name: Void

abilityDetails.Agility: Kaçış (Evade) ve Çeviklik (Dexterity) ustalığının yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen miktarda azaltır.
abilityDetails.Petrify: Düşmanın iyileşme ve güç kazanım hızını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Direct Damage: Zırh ve dirençleri yok sayan doğrudan hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Weakness: Saldırı gücünü düşürür; sıfırın altına inemez.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Rakip herhangi bir negatif efekt yaşarsa doğrudan hasar verir — purify eden veya yetenek azaltan şampiyon kullan. Negatif efekt süresini kısaltan şampiyonlar da iyi.
signatureAbility:
Fear of The Void
When all Intimidating Presence Debuffs are at max stacks, instead of being removed, those Debuffs are converted into a Passive Fear of the Void that combines their effects and grants Void [2,608.1 - 12,804.35] Attack Rating for 40 seconds.
When Fear of the Void is active, Intimidating Presence generates Debuffs [15 - 60]% faster.
Fear of the Void cannot exceed 2 stacks.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: A suffocating, choking, and all-consuming Void provides full immunity to Incinerate effects.
Every 10 seconds, Void's Intimidating Presence inflicts 1 random Debuff. +4 seconds on the timer if at least one Intimidating Presence Debuff is already active.

abilitySections.title: When Attacked
content: Opponents can remove one Intimidating Presence Debuff for every 10 hits on their Combo Meter.

abilitySections.title: Intimidating Presence
content: For each Champion alive on the opponent's team, Intimidating Presence Debuffs have a 0.6 second delay before fully activating.
Agility Debuff: Reduces Ability Accuracy of Evade and the Dexterity Mastery by 30%. Max Stacks: 2
Fatigue Debuff: Reduces Critical Rating by [1,480.77]. Max Stacks: 2
Petrify Debuff of 50% Potency. Max Stacks: 2
When all Intimidating Presence Debuffs are at max stacks, those Debuffs will be removed after 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: When Opponents Suffer from a Debuff
content: For each unique Debuff type, the opponent takes [948.4] Direct Damage per second.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Inflicts 1 Intimidating Presence Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Inflicts 2 Dark Stings, each lasting for 12 seconds. An opponent with a Dark Sting gains a Weakness or a Degeneration Debuff per Sting when activating a Special Attack.
Weakness: Reduces Attack Rating by 25% for 20 seconds.
Degeneration: Inflicts [15,174.4] Direct Damage over 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: The strength of this Special Attack is increased based on how many unique Debuffs types are currently active on the opponent.
1 ~ 2 unique Debuffs provide a +20% passive Fury.
3 ~ 4 unique Debuffs provide a +50% passive Fury.
5+ unique Debuffs provide a +250% passive Fury.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Fear of The Void
content: When all Intimidating Presence Debuffs are at max stacks, instead of being removed, those Debuffs are converted into a Passive Fear of the Void that combines their effects and grants Void [2,608.1 - 12,804.35] Attack Rating for 40 seconds.
When Fear of the Void is active, Intimidating Presence generates Debuffs [15 - 60]% faster.
Fear of the Void cannot exceed 2 stacks.
